results.quote: For a single query, HNSecW achieves _O_(log_N_) online searching complexity over a database of size _N_.
For _U_ sequential queries, we propose a multi-query protocol with an amortized cost of _O_(U_log_N_).
We also propose a batch-query protocol with higher parallelism that processes a batch of _U_ queries simultaneously with a much lower critical-path length of _O_(log^2_U_+log_N_).

results.bound: O(log N) critical-path length for single-query; O(U log N) for multiple-query
results.quote: for the single-query protocol, the critical-path length is _O_(log_N_), and for the multiple- query protocol, it is _O_(U_log_N_).
Overall, our single-query MPC protocol achieves logarithmic online search complexity with at most a \(2\times\) increase in vector storage.

results.bound: O(Uk(d + k log^2 k + Uk) + (Ud + U^2) log N)
results.quote: Therefore, the multiple-query protocol has total communication and local computation costs \(O\big(Uk(d+klog^2k+Uk)+(Ud+U^2)logN\big)\).

results.bound: O(log^2 U) round complexity (reduced from O(U))
results.quote: We propose a batch protocol that processes the U queries in parallel, reducing the round complexity from O(U) to O(log^2 U).
